title: CAM Deep AI — Fusion 360 + HyperMill Deep Learning, Reasoning, and Integration

units.title: Fusion 360 Deep Learning domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 Fusion 360 deep learning domains: fusion_feature_learning (GNN/PointNet), fusion_toolpath_learning (Transformer/seq2seq), fusion_setup_learning (classification), fusion_simulation_learning (anomaly detection), fusion_video_learning (Whisper/Vision), fusion_pdf_learning (extraction), fusion_example_mining (pattern mining), fusion_style_transfer (GAN)

units.title: Fusion 360 Deep Reasoning domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 Fusion 360 deep reasoning domains: fusion_causal_reasoning (Causal DAGs), fusion_operation_sequencing (critical path), fusion_constraint_satisfaction (SAT/SMT), fusion_tradeoff_analysis (Pareto), fusion_what_if_analysis (Monte Carlo), fusion_debugging_reasoning (FTA), fusion_optimization_reasoning (NSGA-II), fusion_validation_reasoning (ASME Y14.5)

units.title: HyperMill Deep Learning domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 HyperMill deep learning domains: hypermill_strategy_learning (classification), hypermill_parameter_learning (Bayesian), hypermill_template_mining (PrefixSpan), hypermill_style_fingerprinting (embedding), hypermill_anomaly_detection (Isolation Forest), hypermill_toolpath_embedding (Code2Vec), hypermill_operation_clustering (K-means), hypermill_performance_prediction (gradient boosting)

units.title: HyperMill Deep Reasoning domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 HyperMill deep reasoning domains: hypermill_strategy_reasoning (justification), hypermill_collision_reasoning (spatial), hypermill_cycle_optimization (TSP), hypermill_fixture_reasoning (force/moment), hypermill_multiaxis_reasoning (kinematic), hypermill_rest_machining_reasoning (stock sim), hypermill_tolerance_reasoning (stack-up), hypermill_post_reasoning (controller)

units.title: CAM Bridge Integration domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 CAM bridge integration domains: cam_bridge_automation (Fusion↔hyperMILL), cam_live_execution (HTTP/WebSocket), cam_workflow_orchestration (pipelines), cam_parameter_optimization (cross-system), cam_resource_allocation (shop config), cam_queue_management (priority), cam_error_recovery (classification), cam_batch_processing (family-of-parts)

units.title: Expert prompts and tribal synthesis
units.details: Created Claude Opus-level expert prompts for all 40 domains referencing: fusion360-cam-tips.ts (39 tips), hypermill-* catalogs, VideoLearningEngine.ts, Fusion360LiveBridgeEngine.ts, HyperMillStrategyEngine.ts. Added all domains to manufacturingDomains tribal synthesis array.

units.title: Comprehensive test suite
units.details: 84 tests covering: Fusion learning (16), Fusion reasoning (16), HyperMill learning (16), HyperMill reasoning (16), CAM bridge (16), tribal synthesis (4)

domains: fusion_feature_learning — GNN/PointNet for feature trees, Tree-LSTM
fusion_toolpath_learning — Sequence models, Transformer for toolpaths
fusion_video_learning — Whisper + Vision for video tutorials
fusion_pdf_learning — PDF extraction from Autodesk docs
fusion_example_mining — Pattern mining from sample files
hypermill_cycle_optimization — Critical path, TSP for tools

ml_architectures.anomaly: Isolation Forest, autoencoder, one-class SVM, LOF
ml_architectures.reasoning: SAT/SMT (Z3), Causal DAGs, Monte Carlo, FTA

integration_points.Fusion360LiveBridgeEngine: Live session control via HTTP API
integration_points.camDispatcher: Available for routing to CAM AI reasoning

summary: Comprehensive CAM Deep AI with 40 new domains across 5 categories: Fusion 360 Deep Learning (8 domains for feature/toolpath/setup/simulation learning, video/PDF extraction), Fusion 360 Deep Reasoning (8 domains for causal/constraint/tradeoff/optimization reasoning), HyperMill Deep Learning (8 domains for strategy/parameter/template learning, anomaly detection), HyperMill Deep Reasoning (8 domains for strategy/collision/cycle/tolerance reasoning), CAM Bridge Integration (8 domains for automation/execution/workflow/batch processing). Leverages fusion360-cam-tips.ts, hypermill-* catalogs, VideoLearningEngine, resources folders. 84 tests passing. Ready for PRISM CLI integration.
